clue.text: The No. 1 seed?

parts.note: seed is read not as a tennis ranking but as offspring, and number one is the eldest child of a family

explanation.surface: A question about the top-ranked player in a tennis tournament.
explanation.definitionFit: Seed in its old sense means offspring, and the first of a parent's offspring is the eldest child.

clue.text: Data in notebook

parts.note: the clue simply describes what gets written down in a notebook of record: hard information

explanation.surface: Figures jotted down in a pad.
explanation.definitionFit: Data are pieces of information, and items of established information are what a record notebook holds.

clue.text: Apostates turn recanters

indicators.note: to turn something is to change it round, so the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: People who abandon their faith become those who take back their words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' rearranges RECANTERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Recreants are deserters of a faith or cause, the same thing as apostates.

clue.text: Stage set for cheat on trial

indicators.note: something set is arranged or put in order, so these letters are laid out anew

explanation.surface: A courtroom scene arranged for a fraudster facing prosecution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set' rearranges CHEAT and TRIAL together; 'on' only joins the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, stage (as in stage effects) means belonging to the theatre.

clue.text: Keep watch

definitions.meaning: to keep a rule or a festival is to honour it in practice
to watch is to look at attentively

explanation.definitionFit: The verb has both senses: obeying a law or custom, and looking at something closely.

clue.text: Starting climb heading north

indicators.note: the climb is headed by the next piece, which therefore comes first

parts.note: N is the compass abbreviation for north
a climb is an ascent

explanation.surface: Beginning an ascent that points northwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading' tells you north stands at the head of the climb, so N comes before ASCENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nascent is just coming into being, which is to say starting out.

clue.text: Band succeeded when on tour

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for succeeded in family trees
being on tour is being on a trip

explanation.surface: A music group did well while travelling round the country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when' only links the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip is a long narrow piece, the same as a band of material.

clue.text: Miss becoming captain

definitions.meaning: to miss something out is to leave it out or pass over it
the captain of a bowls or curling team is called by this short name, from skipper

explanation.walkthrough: 'becoming' only joins the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means to omit or leave out, and also the captain of a team, short for skipper.

clue.text: This relates to nose of wild animal

definitions.meaning: as a word-forming element, from Greek, it refers to the nose, as in the term for nose surgery
a large horned beast of Africa and Asia

explanation.walkthrough: 'of' joins the two definitions; the first sense is the combining form meaning nose.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek combining form means nose, and the same letters are the short name for the horned beast.

clue.text: One Quaker speaking to another, or one writing to another

definitions.meaning: Quakers are the Society of Friends; William Penn, a Quaker, would hail a fellow member as a Friend
a correspondent who exchanges letters with someone, often abroad

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is a jokey picture: Penn the Quaker addressing a fellow Friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A correspondent one writes to by post, often never met, is called by this two-word name.

clue.text: Hiding place for money, say

indicators.note: say marks a word spoken out, so the money word is heard rather than written

parts.note: money in coins and notes is cash

explanation.surface: A secret stash where you keep your savings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' gives a word sounding like CASH. 'for' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: A cache is a hidden store, a concealed spot where things are kept.

clue.text: A hint of mistrust

definitions.meaning: a slight trace or touch of something, as in a faint taste of garlic

explanation.walkthrough: 'of' joins the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means both a slight trace of something and a feeling that someone is guilty or untrustworthy.

clue.text: Mild cheese right from the plant

parts.note: mild in flavour can be sweet
Brie is a soft French cheese

explanation.surface: A gentle cheese made correctly from plant matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the' only links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweetbrier is a wild rose with fragrant leaves, a kind of plant.

clue.text: Berth in back cabin

indicators.note: back tells you to read the cabin word from end to start

parts.note: a cabin on a ship is a room

explanation.surface: A sleeping place at the rear of a ship's cabin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' reverses ROOM. 'in' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: To berth a ship is to tie it up at a quay, which is to moor it.

clue.text: Slump into a state of despair

definitions.meaning: an economic slump, a long fall in trade
a mental condition of deep gloom

explanation.walkthrough: 'into' only joins the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an economic downturn and a condition of low spirits.

clue.text: Writer's riddle said to make one thoughtful

indicators.note: said marks the phrase as spoken, so what counts is how it sounds

parts.note: a writer is a pen, giving pen's, and a riddle is a coarse sieve, so the phrase is pen's sieve

explanation.surface: An author's puzzle, spoken aloud, gets someone thinking.
explanation.walkthrough: A riddle here is not a puzzle but a coarse sieve; 'said' turns PEN'S SIEVE into a word it sounds like. 'to make one' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Pensive means lost in thought, the same as thoughtful.

clue.text: Couple steps out with energy to perform dance figure

indicators.note: to perform the letters is to work them into a new routine, so they are rearranged

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A pair take to the floor with vigour to show a dance move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to perform' rearranges STEPSOUT with E. 'Couple' is part of the picture: the figure is danced by couples swinging round.
explanation.definitionFit: A poussette is a country-dance figure in which partners hold hands and swing round.

clue.text: Sentimentality becomes Electra

indicators.note: becomes signals that the next name turns into something else, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Gooey feeling suits the tragic Greek heroine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becomes' rearranges ELECTRA.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacle, figuratively, is cloying sentimentality.

clue.text: Turn place upside down when drunk

indicators.note: turning something upside down jumbles it, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A drunk wrecks the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upside down' rearranges TURN and PLACE together. 'when' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Crapulent means sick from drinking too much, so drunk.

clue.text: Updike has to be an interloper

parts.note: the novelist's surname begins with the two letters U and P, so it has those letters at its start

explanation.surface: John Updike must be an outsider who pushes in.
explanation.walkthrough: The joke is that the name opens on UP: it has UP at its START.
explanation.definitionFit: An upstart is someone who has risen suddenly and pushes in where they are not welcome.

clue.text: Riddle of the top German general

indicators.note: top marks the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: Erwin Rommel was the German general known as the Desert Fox

explanation.surface: A puzzle about the leading Nazi commander.
explanation.walkthrough: Riddle is not a puzzle but a coarse sieve. 'of' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: A trommel is a revolving cylindrical sieve for ore, and a riddle is a coarse sieve.

clue.text: Fish to bring ashore from the bay

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted fish
to land something is to bring it ashore

explanation.surface: Fishing from a sea bay and landing the catch.
explanation.walkthrough: The bay is not a stretch of sea but bay leaves, woven into a victor's wreath. 'from' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: A wreath of bay leaves was the classical crown of victory, a kind of garland.

clue.text: Mechanic who can make things run more smoothly?

definitions.text: Mechanic who can make things run more smoothly?

parts.words: Mechanic who can make things run more smoothly?
parts.note: a garage worker who applies lubricant; also slang for someone who smooths the way by flattering

explanation.surface: A garage worker who keeps machines running sweetly.
explanation.definitionFit: A mechanic who lubricates machinery is literally one who applies grease.

clue.text: Location a blot on landscape, say

indicators.note: say marks a word spoken out, so the eyesore word is heard rather than written

parts.note: an eyesore is called a sight, as in looking a sight

explanation.surface: A place that spoils the view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' gives a word sounding like SIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: A site is a place where something is or happens, a location.

clue.text: Clothes to suit a pretty little daughter

parts.note: something twee is quaintly pretty and dainty

explanation.surface: Outfits fit for a sweet small girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to suit a' only links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Tweeds are suits and jackets made of rough woollen cloth, so clothes.

clue.text: Masseur left to restore full body movement

indicators.note: to restore is to put back in order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A massage therapist is left to bring back a client's mobility.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restore' rearranges MASSEUR, L and TO together.
explanation.definitionFit: A somersault is a forward or backward roll in which the whole body turns over.

clue.text: Small contribution from birdman

parts.note: a tit is a small bird
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A bird enthusiast makes a modest donation.
explanation.walkthrough: Birdman splits into bird and man. 'from' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: A tithe is a tenth part given to the church, hence any small levy or contribution.

clue.text: Hatred shown by this state to Israel

indicators.note: this word plus the Israel word gives hatred, so taking that away leaves the answer

parts.note: an aversion is a strong dislike
Sion is a variant spelling of Zion, a name for Israel

explanation.surface: Hostility displayed by this country towards Israel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shown by this' means this word, with Sion added, makes AVERSION. 'to' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: To aver is to state firmly, to declare as true.

clue.text: Year books?

parts.note: a year is twelve months, and a book of small format folded into twelve leaves per sheet has a name built on the number twelve

explanation.surface: Annual volumes.
explanation.definitionFit: Books in the duodecimo format, sheets folded into twelve leaves, are named after the number of months in a year.

clue.text: That's Latin for you!

parts.note: read literally, the Latin phrase for that is, abbreviated i.e.; the surface is an exasperated remark about a dead language

explanation.surface: An exclamation about how hard Latin is.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means that is, so the clue's opening words translate it exactly.

clue.text: A more mature tree

definitions.meaning: older, in the comparative sense used of siblings
a shrub or small tree with white flowers and dark berries

explanation.definitionFit: The word means older, of two people, and also names the small tree with berries used for wine.

clue.text: See good and clear on holding this

definitions.text: See good and clear on holding this

parts.note: lo is an old exclamation meaning look or see

indicators.note: holding means the next pair of pieces is held inside the on word

parts.note: re means on, in the sense of concerning
nett means clear, as in clear profit after deductions

explanation.surface: A handheld device that helps you look properly and plainly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' puts good and clear inside the on word; 'and' only links. Read whole, the clue describes the handled eyeglasses themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: A lorgnette is a pair of spectacles held up on a handle, which you hold to see well and clearly.
